recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle action shot of five women in synchronized water skiing formation, wearing pink swimsuits and white tutus, set against blue ocean water with white foam. The composition features bold, overlapping geometric triangles in the top left and a stylized script logo in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal line of skiers mirroring the angle of the geometric shapes
Vibrant pink and white costumes contrasting against the deep blue water
Dynamic white water spray framing the subjects
Balance between heavy geometric blocks at top-left and light script at bottom-right

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Five skiers arranged in a receding diagonal line from bottom-left to center-right, occupying the middle ground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The lead skier in the bottom-left and the large geometric title block in the top-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal line of the skiers upward and right, then circles back to the top-left title and down to the bottom-right script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue water surface provides significant negative space in the top-right and bottom-left corners.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cerulean blue and white foam (background and environment)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic elements and costumes against a naturally textured, medium-value water background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon colors; stick to 1980s primary and secondary saturated tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast serif and fluid brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Bold, high-contrast Didone-style serifs placed individually on geometric planes.
Bottom text: Casual, monolinear brush script with exaggerated ascenders and descenders.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' in the script is oversized and acts as a container for the rest of the word.
Serif letters are rotated to match the tilt of their background triangles.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hard-edged geometric serif paired with organic, loose script for a 'vacation' feel.
graphicDevices: White border around the top graphic block
Stylized water wave icon under script

preserve: The contrast between the rigid top text and fluid bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, bold serif look for the top text.
Captures the 80s brush-script energy for the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1980s-style photograph of five women in pink swimsuits and white tutus water skiing in a diagonal line on blue ocean water with heavy white spray. Leave the top-left and bottom-right corners clear for graphics.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a series of overlapping colorful triangles (green, pink, purple, orange) in the top left with bold black serif letters. Add a white brush-script word in the bottom right with a small blue wave icon underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the script text white and legible against the water?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Check for vintage color grading (slight yellow/cyan shift)
Ensure the tutus look like physical fabric, not digital shapes
Verify the diagonal alignment of the skiers
Confirm the graphic elements have a 'cut-and-paste' collage feel
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Action Photo + Geometric Staggered Serif + Fluid Brush Script + 80s Color Palette
